result.summary: The home screen is largely intact. The only notable visual problem is the promotional banner, where the circular background decoration clips through the rounded card corners.

issues.description: The green promo card’s large circular background shapes overflow the card’s rounded corners instead of being clipped, so the decoration breaks the intended rounded rectangle.
issues.suggestion: Set overflow: hidden (or equivalent clip) on the promo card so the decorative circles stay inside the rounded bounds.
